Doctor '''Kerrian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] that led a Republic archaeological team that ventured into the [[Deep Cradle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. Unlucky, Kerrian and the entire expedition went insane; with only the excavator [[Lefry Kaonai|Lefry]] not sharing their fate because he had undertaken a Voss ritual that protected him from the influence of the [[Nightmare Lands]].
Later arrived the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] and the [[Voss Mystics|mystic-in training]], [[Gaden-Ko]]. Upon Lefry's request, the Jedi tracked Kerrian to retrieve his [[Holojournal/Legends|holojournal]] for information of that region; however all the effort of the Barsen'thor to cure Kerrian from his insanity went futile, and the Jedi was forced to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the scientist.
